name: ZAG Fire Laboratory Gameljne
zag_role: Fire testing, original ZAG fire facility
description: ZAG built its first dedicated fire laboratory here in 1986. It remained the institute's fire testing base until the Logatec laboratory opened.
history: ZAG built its first dedicated fire laboratory here in 1986 and it remained the fire testing base of the institute until the Logatec laboratory opened in 2022.
facts: 1986, the first dedicated ZAG fire laboratory
fire testing base of the institute until 2022
the Logatec Fire Laboratory, opened September 2022

source_differences: Heights of cadastre buildings 38 and 71: the cadastre gives 10.1 m and 6.7 m for the highest points above the terrain, while 99 % of the laser scan surface inside the outlines stays below 12.6 m and 10.6 m. Buildings 1095 and 1096 have no height in the cadastre, and the laser scan gives 4.9 m and 5.6 m as the middle of the surface inside their outlines. Laser scanning of Slovenia (GURS, CLSS, file series NDMP), read 12 November 2026.
open_question: OpenStreetMap tags the building at this address as residential and gives it no name, so the map confirms the address and not the laboratory.

laser_scan.source: GURS, laser scanning of Slovenia (CLSS), file series NDMP, 0.5 m pixels. The values are read as heights above the ground. This reading rests on the agreement with the cadastre heights, since no official description of the series was found
